name: PhyloSpec
description: A VS Code extension providing syntax highlighting and language support for the PhyloSpec modeling language.
author: CODEPhylo steering group

scripts.build:lsp: mvn -f ../../core/java/pom.xml -DskipTests package && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('server', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('../../core/java/target/phylospec-lsp-jar-with-dependencies.jar', 'server/phylospec-lsp.jar');"
scripts.publish: git clean -xfd node_modules && npm i && npm run build:lsp && npm run compile && vsce publish
